designDecisions: PER-REGIME REFs — SHELL_REFS = { 'icy-active': Europa's live slots, 'volatile-cold': Titan's, 'eyeball-despun': Eyeball's }, builder shellDriversToTune(drivers, regime). Evidence (GROUNDING §2, all verified by headless runs): the three golden-pinned shell presets occupy three DISJOINT regimes (one preset per regime — the property plates lacked), so per-regime anchoring nulls all three exactly. The plates precedent does NOT transfer: driversToTune anchors only at D_EARTH and the live Ocean bundle returns a NON-NULL tune (UPLIFT_GAIN 1.647...) that was baked into Ocean's golden at capture — that pin-as-tuned path is CLOSED for shell (goldens already pinned tune-less, NEVER re-capture). A single-REF null-zone cannot satisfy the house exact-only === guard at three driver points without dead zones in exactly the space this increment opens.

REF DISCIPLINE = READ-SURFACE-MATCHED (the VENUS_REF pattern, not MAGMA_REF synthetic-neutral): frozen literals with derivation expressions (massGravity as mass/R² e.g. 0.07/(0.5*0.5); tidal slots derived inline from preset orbital constants per the plates EARTH_TIDAL_HEATING pattern — never hand-typed long decimals; no cross-import from driver-presets.js). Guards: null/{} → null FIRST; exact-only identity per regime; unknown regime → icy-active REF (mirrors the writer's REGIME_WEIGHTS fallback); AC-TUNE-NULL(c) pins every REF slot === the live-constructed bundle slot to full float precision (non-circular).

SEED-STABILITY RULE (new, shell-specific): the builder NEVER reads condition.radiusEarth — it is the DRAWN radius (seed-varying for seeded archetype worlds). Grep-enforced in AC-0's denylist. All consumed slots are fp-stable: flat massGravity/volatileFraction/tidalHeating + nested condition.T_eq.

RESPONSE AXES (all research-free; the stress mechanism + its Melosh/Beuthe/Hoppa constants stay FROZEN): A1 gravity → RIDGE_AMP + CHAOS_AMP + CHAOS_BASE via ONE common gFactor = clamp(0.4, 2.5, (massGravity/REF)^-0.5) (the house convention, plates/magmatism precedent; relief ∝ 1/g) — THE HEADLINE AXIS; A2 rawTidal → CREST_THRESH + TENSILE_THRESH via clamped LOG10-ratio deviation (within-regime tidal spans ~10 decades: Titan 1.6e-8 → Europa 1.4e2; linear/clamp01 would die or saturate; log10(REF/REF)=0 exactly → null-safe; the log-ratio transfer shape is NEW to the family — flagged); A3 thermal vigor (nested T_eq + flat volatileFraction) → CELL_MIN within a clamp (finer convection planform; structurally inert on eyeball-despun, CHAOS_W 0 skips STEP-2 — physically correct); A4 T_eq → CHAOS_THRESH down on warm shells (more melt-through chaos; IN per recommendation, Max may strike; gains UAT-tunable). AGE OMITTED — honors Max's 2026-06-28 plates descope ('age IS history'). shellThickness DEFERRED behind K_SHELL=0 (the V2-2b-1 K_G=0 precedent).

SAFE-KEYS vs LOAD-BEARING (the anti-mush discipline; shellRelief has no BASE_* floors — its structural equivalents are protected instead): tune may return ONLY {CELL_MIN, CREST_THRESH, TENSILE_THRESH, CHAOS_THRESH, RIDGE_AMP, CHAOS_AMP, CHAOS_BASE} (key-set asserted in AC-ORDER). NEVER returned: DESPIN_REF/DIUR_REF/DIUR_PEAK (STRESS_REF calibration — tuning silently re-balances regime character), SHOULDER_HT/TROUGH_DEPTH (double-ridge cross-section shape — A1 scales the whole profile via RIDGE_AMP so ridges stay double-ridged at every drive), SHELL_BASE/RELAX_PASSES/SHELL_BOUND, BELT_RADIANS/WARP_*/DETAIL_*/RIDGE_FREQ/CHAOS_FREQ (resolution/texture calibration), REGIME_WEIGHTS (regime identity; not in the seam). Blast-radius property worth asserting: the tune touches neither stressTensile nor thetaTraj, so carrier.grainAngle + faultDensity (two of five hashed golden fields) stay byte-stable even under drive — only height (+ lineament/chaos diag) responds.

DISPATCH THREADING mirrors #4-M/V2-2b-1 verbatim at BOTH call sites (the V2-3 derived shell() helper AND the migration bridge): pass bodyDrivers as the drivers arg (byte-safe — the writer voids it), tune: shellDriversToTune(bodyDrivers, regime), shellDiag.appliedTune = tune. The regime arg is dispatch-provided derived context (the same tuple REGIME_WEIGHTS[regime] consumes) — declared in AC-0, not a label read inside the builder. CELL_MIN overrides change 'shell:cells:' draw counts — deterministic per (seed, tune), the CORONA_POOL precedent, named in AC1 so a reviewer doesn't misread it as a determinism break.
